prompt: Green trades lunch for a dinosaur book
title: Lunch for Dinosaur Book
irony: Green trades his lunch to learn about hungry giants, so the dino expert goes hungry until sharing the book brings lunch back.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Noon light fills Gold's Diner as Green stares at Black's big dinosaur book beside his lunch tray.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green lists dino names, corrects Black's rex facts, and begs to swap his lunch tray for the book.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black swaps the book for Green's lunch, leaving Green with tasty facts and a growling empty tummy.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Kids chant lunch-for-book around the table as Green hugs the book and Black grabs the tray.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: On the village bench Green reads nonstop, refuses Navy's bread bite, and his legs wobble with hunger.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Green's tummy roars like a rex, pages flutter, and he drops the book in dust reaching for crumbs.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Gold joins the chant at the bench as Green hugs pages and Black lifts the empty tray.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Back in the diner Gold watches hungry Green and remembers feeding hungry folks on rainy days.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold cuts his own sandwich in half for Green, and Green offers dino facts and pages to share.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: All sing lunch-for-book turned to shared book and shared lunch as trays return to the table.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Noon light fills the diner again as friends share lunch bites and roar rex facts together.
